summary: PIMCO Asset-Based Lending Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of LLC interests across eight share classes for about $59.1 million in aggregate cash consideration, with final share counts fixed September 28, 2026, alongside a September 30 distribution declaration payable October 20. Transactional NAV per share ranged from $10.20 to $10.29 as of August 31, 2026. Sales were exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and Regulation S to accredited and non-U.S. investors. This is a routine interval-fund continuous offering and distribution notice, not a special situation; watch DRIP-driven dilution and NAV stability.
